Example: ``` example (α : Type) (a b : α) (p : α → Prop) (h1 : a = b) (h2 : p a) : p b := Eq.subst h1 h2 example (α : Type) (a b : α) (p : α → Prop) (h1 : a = b) (h2 : p a) : p b := h1 ▸ h2 ``` The triangle in the second presentation is a macro built on top of `Eq.subst` and `Eq.symm`, and you can enter it by typing `\t`.
